answer: Random peer audits stop a voyage of fake identities. A new agent locks 120 credits in a vault, then 5 random peers audit its work and stake each epoch; failure burns the deposit and flags its referrer. Forging 100 identities costs 12,000 credits, and one ripple of audits exposes the cluster, since auditors are redrawn each round. An honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and earns undiluted rewards because fakes are removed before payout.
